_comment: Label → Markdown block styling for the det-token parsers. 'default' applies to every model; 'overrides' is keyed by OCR model adapter id (src/models/*) and wins where it names a label. Styles: text | heading | image | italic | equation | table. A heading may pin its level with {"style": "heading", "level": 2}. Unmapped labels render as plain text. Changing a mapping here needs no rebuild; a malformed or missing file falls back to the table compiled into src/parsers/BlockStyle.cpp.
